POS system with fiscal module

Fast checkout, receipts that meet tax rules, Click and Payme QR payments, and sales from every branch in one report. An MVP in 8–12 weeks, from UZS 180 mln; the full version in 16–30 weeks.

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • POS app for tablets or touch terminals
